name: heap_doubly_linked.k
model:
class DLLNode {
  var value:Int
  var prev:DLLNode
  var next:DLLNode
}

var head:DLLNode

var middle:DLLNode

var tail:DLLNode

req head != middle

req middle != tail

req head != tail

req head.value = 1

req middle.value = 2

req tail.value = 3

req head.next = middle

req middle.next = tail

req middle.prev = head

req tail.prev = middle

; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))

; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (head Ref)(middle Ref)(tail Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((DLLNode (mk-DLLNode (value Int)(prev Ref)(next Ref)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-DLLNode (sel-DLLNode DLLNode))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-DLLNode ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-DLLNode (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-DLLNode ((this Ref)) DLLNode
  (sel-DLLNode (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-DLLNode ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-DLLNode this)
)

;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.head: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!head ((this Ref)) Ref

)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.middle: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!middle ((this Ref)) Ref

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.tail: ---

; ------------------------------

(define-fun DLLNode.value ((this Ref)) Int

; --- getters for DLLNode.prev: ---

; --- getters for DLLNode.next: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))
